metrics.rationale: User requests '尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号' (receive 1000-1700 nm SWIR signal as completely as possible) for methane absorption feature detection.
User requests '尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射' (reflect 300-450 nm UV/blue stray radiation as much as possible) to reduce solar scattering background.

standard.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly encode the dual-band requirement: high transmission in the methane-sensing SWIR band (1000-1700 nm) and high reflection in the UV/blue rejection band (300-450 nm). I deliberately omit absorption metrics since the user's goal is spectral filtering (transmit signal, reject background), not thermal management. I also omit worst-case metrics because the user says '尽可能' (as much as possible) which implies average performance optimization rather than guaranteeing every single wavelength point. Two metrics suffice; adding more would dilute the ranking without capturing additional user intent.
standard.formula_rationale: The user requires both high transmission for methane detection and high reflection for background suppression, phrased as 'as completely as possible' for both bands. Since neither goal is prioritized over the other in the request, the expression adds the two metrics directly. Each term contributes positively because both variables have a 'maximize' direction, ensuring the score increases only when signal throughput improves or stray light rejection improves.
